unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U21: Map withholding,remittance,reporting and identity compliance without converting thresholds to caps

payload.title: Withholding is a compliance chain
payload.core_explanation_md:
For a covered payment, identify its character, recipient status, applicable law, trigger and rate. Deduction, depositing tax, reporting the transaction and issuing the required certificate are separate tasks. A deduction in the bank ledger is not evidence that Government remittance and statement reconciliation occurred. PAN identifies the taxpayer; TAN concerns the deductor framework described in the source.

Non-resident and treaty treatment needs the relevant eligibility and documentary conditions rather than an automatic lowest-number rule. Likewise, a reporting or identification threshold is not necessarily a prohibition on receiving a larger deposit. The book contains dated and overbroad shorthand; current rates, deadlines and disallowance proportions must be checked before publication.

self_check.prompt_text: Does recording TDS automatically prove timely Government remittance?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Deduction, deposit and reporting need separate evidence.

payload.stem_md: Tax is deducted in the accounts, but no remittance or statement record exists. Which conclusion is justified?

options.text_md: Only deduction is evidenced; the remaining compliance steps need reconciliation
options.explanation_md: One step does not prove the whole chain.

options.text_md: Every reporting obligation is automatically complete

options.explanation_md: Withholding does not itself establish exemption.

options.text_md: A reporting threshold forbids all larger transactions

payload.correct_explanation_md: One step does not prove the whole chain.

payload.stem_md: An account policy calls a tax-reporting threshold a universal legal deposit ceiling without evidence. What is required?

options.text_md: Keep the cap because it is a round amount
options.explanation_md: Rounding is not a legal basis.

options.text_md: Assume identification and prohibition always mean the same
options.explanation_md: They impose different kinds of duties.

options.text_md: Identify whether the rule concerns reporting, identity, withholding or an actual prohibition
options.explanation_md: The operative obligation must be characterised accurately.

options.text_md: Ignore all tax rules for electronic deposits
options.explanation_md: Channel alone does not remove statutory duties.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The operative obligation must be characterised accurately.
